name: Ceramic and Glass Design
overview: Ceramic and Glass Design is an enthralling and artistic discipline that combines design concepts with the media of ceramics and glass. It blends traditional craftsmanship with modern technologies like digital modeling and 3D printing. Contemporary designers create functional objects, architectural installations, and wearable art while emphasizing sustainable practices.
